title: Payment Arrangements — Resuming a Suspended Plan After a Hold Ends
content:
## The rule in force

When the hold that suspended a plan has ended and the consumer agrees to restart, the plan resumes: the first installment after resumption is the first unpaid installment, later installments follow on the plan's frequency, and the final due date moves by the same amount.

A suspended plan is not resumed until its installment history carries a missed entry for the last installment whose pre-suspension grace had run out by the date missed-installment counting stopped.

Stated as a condition on the record: a suspended plan whose installment history does not yet carry that missed entry is not resumed.

This applies to plans under Payment Arrangements suspended for a hold that has since ended. The number of calendar days from the resumption date to the due date of the first installment after resumption is the plan's restart days.

## What the resumption does

The arrangement's status returns to active; the named installment becomes the first installment after resumption, falling due the given number of calendar days after today; every later installment follows on the arrangement's frequency (weekly, every two weeks, or the same day of each following month), and the final due date is moved accordingly. Amounts and the installment count are not changed. The consumer can afterwards see the arrangement active again, with the new first due date and the new final due date.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `resume_suspended_plan_416c1e83`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `plan_id` | The payment plan reference number (the identifier) of the suspended arrangement, as returned by the payment arrangement lookup for the consumer | Identifier string |
| `first_installment_number` | The number of the installment that falls due first after resumption | Non-negative integer |
| `days_to_first_installment` | The calendar days from today to the due date of that first installment | Non-negative integer of whole calendar days |

## Return

On success the tool returns a record rendered as text with `plan_id`, `status` (always `active`), `first_installment`, `first_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `final_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `resumed_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today); a status of `active` shows the arrangement has resumed.

When no arrangement matches the reference given, the tool returns "No payment plan found for" followed by that reference, and nothing is changed.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

Resuming a monthly arrangement of 12 installments with installment 7 as the first installment after resumption and 21 days to it, on a handling date of 3 August, gives a first due date of 24 August and moves installment 8 onward to the 24th of each following month, the final due date being the date of the last installment on that schedule.
